title: Fröberg conjecture on the Hilbert functions of a set of forms
exact_target: Does the quotient by generic forms have the Hilbert series predicted by the product formula, truncated from its first negative coefficient onward?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7200006 (AMR-071-0006). CC BY 4.0.
Ralf Fröberg and Samuel Lundqvist, Extremal Hilbert series (2017). Sections 1–2, Conjecture 1, pp. 1–3.
